channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: 1 killed, 6 injured in Jawzjan traffic accident
item.description: One person has been killed and six others, including women and children, injured in a traffic accident in northern Jawzjan province, officials said on Monday.

item.title: 50m afs development project kicks off at Logar University
item.description: Construction has begun on a 50 million afghanis project to build internal roads at Logar University in central Logar province, an official said on Monday.

item.title: Kim Jong Un re-appointed as North Korea’s Workers’ Party leader
item.description: orth Korean leader Kim Jong Un has been re-appointed as secretary-general of the ruling Workers’ Party, extending his leadership of the country’s sole governing party, media reports said on Monday.

item.title: Pakistani airstrikes: 5 missing in Nangarhar
item.description: Five people remain missing following Saturday night’s airstrikes by the Pakistani military in Behsud district of eastern Nangarhar, while two children were injured in Khogyani district and another child was shot and wounded in Momandara.

item.title: 15 killed in military helicopter crash in Peru
item.description: All 15 people on board a military helicopter have died after it crashed in the Arequipa region of southern Peru, a media report said on Tuesday.

item.title: Bennett voices concern over civilian casualties in Pakistani strikes
item.description: UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in Afghanistan Richard Bennett has voiced deep concern over civilian casualties resulting from Pakistani military airstrikes in Afghanistan.

item.title: Afghan man injures 3 in knife attack in Germany
item.description: A 35-year-old Afghan man has reportedly injured three people in a knife attack in the city of Würzburg, Germany, a media report said on Tuesday.

item.title: Khalilzad urges OIC, international community to condemn Pakistani strikes on Afghanistan
item.description: Former US Special Representative for Afghanistan Zalmay Khalilzad has urged the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) and the international community to censure Pakistan’s military strikes on Afghanistan.
